Backend: 14/14 new pytest cases passing in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py — create+masking, list, get with/without reveal, PUT-empty preserves secret, PUT-nonempty updates, DELETE→404, /test live path returns ok:false with authority/token failure message and populated latency_ms, plus 404 on missing IDs, plus a project autofill regression that verifies backend project.source_tenant.client_secret matches the reveal=true plaintext. Regression: 57/57 iter1+iter2+iter3 tests still passing (total 71/71). Frontend: Settings sidebar link routes to /app/settings, Add connection modal opens (data-testid=new-connection-btn) with required label/tenant_id/client_id/client_secret, submit shows sonner toast + closes modal + card appears with masked secret (bullets, no plaintext leak in DOM). Edit modal pre-fills label/domain/tenant_id/client_id/notes; client_secret input is empty with placeholder '•••••••• (unchanged)' — submitting without changing secret preserves the original (verified via reveal=true fetch). Test button calls /test; delete removes card after confirmation. Projects Create-modal shows ↓ load from saved… dropdowns for both source_tenant and destination_tenant, selecting an option autofills tenant_id/client_id/client_secret/domain/label; created project's source_tenant.client_secret equals the resolved plaintext from ?reveal=true.

issues: Empty state text 'No saved tenant connections yet.' is centered and readable; good contrast on #050505 with #00e5ff accent. Consider adding a hint pointing operators to grant admin consent AFTER first save (the tip block below is fine but visually separated).
Masked secret (first-2 + bullets + last-4) is displayed in monospace and truncates correctly. Delete button uses uses a red border/text — good affordance. No accessibility issues observed.

'↓ load from saved…' select is on the right of each tenant panel header — discoverable. Currently the dropdown is only rendered when savedConnections.length>0, so first-time users won't see it (expected behaviour, non-blocking).

action_items: None blocking. All iteration-4 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:851-857 (_connection_out): when reveal=true the function returns the raw client_secret plaintext BUT also leaves the client_secret_masked field absent — good. However there is no additional audit/log entry when reveal=true is used; consider adding a minimal audit log row (who/when) since this endpoint is the only way a full secret ever leaves the DB. Recommended: db.audit_logs.insert_one({actor: user_id, action: 'connection.reveal', connection_id, ts}) inside get_tenant_connection when reveal is True.

server.py:889-904 (update_tenant_connection): the PUT accepts the same TenantConnectionBody used for create where label is required. If an operator PUTs with only {client_secret: 'xxx'} they'll fail with a 422 for missing label. Consider a separate TenantConnectionUpdate model with all fields optional, so partial updates are supported.

server.py:913-919 (test_tenant_connection): swallows all exceptions inside graph_adapter.test_connection but does not surface the connection_id in the returned message; if a UI later shows multiple test results it would be helpful to echo the label back too (already in the doc — a small tweak: return {**result, connection_id, label: doc.get('label')}).

server.py:860-869 (create_tenant_connection): stores client_secret in plaintext in Mongo. This is a materially riskier design than iter 1-3. Recommend at least symmetric encryption at rest using an app-managed key from env (e.g. cryptography.Fernet with a key derived from JWT_SECRET or a dedicated CONN_ENCRYPTION_KEY), so a Mongo dump doesn't expose all customer client secrets in plaintext.

SettingsPage.jsx:75-87 (test handler): shows the sonner toast for 4 seconds by default; the MSAL live token attempt can take 3-6 seconds on cold cache — during that window the button label switches to 'testing…' correctly but there is no in-place inline result indicator on the card itself (only the toast). Consider persisting the last test result (ok/mode/latency) on each card so operators can see which connections were verified when.

SettingsPage.jsx:68-73 (delete handler): uses window.confirm() — browser native dialog. Iter 2+ already introduced shadcn/sonner style modals; consider replacing with an in-app AlertDialog for consistency (minor UX; non-blocking).

ProjectsPage.jsx:38-57 (loadConnectionInto): fetches with ?reveal=true which puts the FULL client_secret into React state → the DOM. Even though the input is type=password, the value is inside <input value=...>, and can be trivially read via DevTools or a hostile browser extension. This is unavoidable if the modal must be self-contained, but a safer pattern would be to keep only the connection_id in the form and resolve the secret server-side at project-create time (e.g. body accepts source_connection_id which the API expands). Recommend adding this as a follow-up for iter 5.
